diff_summary: Consolidated delivery protocols and plan, added a fresh-model handoff, preserved all design/scoring gates, reconciled the architecture lock, and paused implementation until owner start.

verification.command:
git diff --check &&
source .agent/models.env && bash scripts/agent/boot.sh &&
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess
base='28c196f'
def original(path):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',base+':'+path],text=True)
plan=Path('docs/overhaul-plan.md').read_text()
old=original('docs/overhaul-plan.md')
assert plan.split('## 2. Design system:',1)[1].split('## 3. Phases',1)[0] == old.split('## 2. Design system:',1)[1].split('## 3. Phases',1)[0], 'Design requirements changed'
assert plan.split('## 6. Definition of done',1)[1].split('## Appendix A',1)[0] == old.split('## 6. Definition of done',1)[1].split('## Appendix A',1)[0], 'Final gates changed'
ids=lambda t: re.findall(r'^\| (T-[0-9]+\+?) \|',t,re.M)
assert ids(plan)==ids(old), 'Phase task IDs changed'
assert len(re.findall(r'^### Phase [0-9]+ ',plan,re.M))==12
evaluation=Path('.agent/protocol/evaluation.md').read_text()
rubric=lambda t:t.split('## Rubric',1)[1].split('## NOT_RUN',1)[0]
assert rubric(evaluation)==rubric(original('.agent/protocol/evaluation.md')), 'Score rubric changed'
next_state=Path('.agent/NEXT_STATE.md').read_text()
scope=re.search(r'^- target_files: (.+)$',next_state,re.M).group(1)
allowed=set(scope.split(', '))
changed=set(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',base],text=True).splitlines())
changed.update(subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard'],text=True).splitlines())
artifact='.agent/results/T-44574.json'
assert changed <= allowed | {artifact}, 'Unexpected files: '+str(sorted(changed-allowed-{artifact}))
assert all(p.endswith('.md') for p in allowed), 'Non-Markdown scope'
assert all(Path(p).is_file() for p in allowed), 'Missing scoped document'
for p in ['.agent/START_HERE.md','.agent/protocol/delivery-workflow.md','.agent/adr/ADR-014-efficient-delivery-workflow.md','backend/app/core/request_database.py','backend/app/core/request_auth.py','backend/app/core/runtime.py','backend/tests/test_contract_snapshot.py','backend/tests/test_route_registration.py','backend/tests/test_api.py']:
    assert Path(p).is_file(), 'Missing handoff reference: '+p
for p in ['.agent/CURRENT_STATE.md','.agent/NEXT_STATE.md']:
    assert 'PAUSED' in Path(p).read_text(), 'Implementation pause missing'
guide=Path('.agent/START_HERE.md').read_text()
assert all('## '+str(i)+'.' in guide for i in range(1,7)), 'Handoff steps incomplete'
assert 'T-44573' in guide and 'superseded' in guide
for p in ['README.md','NEXT_STEPS.md','docs/architecture.md']:
    text=Path(p).read_text()
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]\n]+\]\(([^)\n]+)\)',text):
        if '://' in target or target.startswith('#'):
            continue
        target=target.split('#',1)[0]
        assert (Path(p).parent/target).exists(), 'Broken link: '+p+' -> '+target
print('PASS: 12 phases and '+str(len(ids(plan)))+' task IDs preserved')
print('PASS: design section, final definition of done and score rubric unchanged')
print('PASS: '+str(len(allowed))+' named Markdown documents; no product/test/script/config changes')
print('PASS: handoff paths, six resume steps, pause state and document links')
print('Product suites: NOT_RUN (documentation-only change)')
PY
